description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order Under Section 3 of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order amending the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011, which involves regulatory changes to customs duties and import classifications. It specifies amendments to HS codes and tariff rates for various goods, representing legal/regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The mention of Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
